summary: NetEase, Inc. furnished a Form 6-K attaching its monthly return to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange for October 2026, a routine HKEX disclosure equivalent to a US periodic share-capital update. Authorized capital held at 1,000,300,000,000 ordinary shares of USD 0.0001 par; issued shares excluding treasury moved down 176,855 to 3,201,475,296 while treasury rose 176,855 to 10,580,360, keeping total issued at 3,212,055,656. The company certified 25% public float compliance. No transaction, price, premium, advisor, or closing date appears; nothing for a risk-arb angle beyond ordinary float and buyback mechanics.
